newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield down on Bulgaria 12-mth floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield down on Bulgaria 12-mth floater T-bills.

text.p: Yield fell at Monday's auction of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry 12-month floating interest T-bills due to a cut in the main interest rate and higher average accepted price, central bank figures showed.
The average yield to maturity on the issue was 15.32 percent, down from 36.29 percent at the respective auction a week earlier.
The average accepted price for the issue auctioned today was 99.86 percent of par against 99.54 percent of par for the respective maturity auctioned on June 16.
nterest on the issue is due at maturity. It equals the central bank main interest rate and is adjusted every time the main rate is changed.
A cut in the central bank main interest rate to an effective annual 16.30 percent calculated through accumulation of monthly accruals from 42.24 percent took effect on Monday.
